question: Should phase one allow operator-confirmed archive of activity-unknown native Codex threads when another Codex process may still own them?
rationale: Direct upstream source shows status is scoped to the connected AppServer, so confirmation reduces but cannot technically eliminate cross-process session-integrity risk.

options.title: Accept guarded archive
options.body: Ship archive with immediate fresh status and binding checks, descendant handling, explicit no-other-runner confirmation, and interruption warnings.

options.title: Defer archive
options.body: Ship discovery and safe branch continuation while withholding destructive archive until cross-process ownership fencing exists.

recommendation.title: Accept guarded archive
recommendation.body: Ship archive with immediate fresh status and binding checks, descendant handling, explicit no-other-runner confirmation, and interruption warnings.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current-main Codex supervision foundation and are best positioned to decide its intended phase-one safety boundary.
